headline: Demon44 Wins by 88 While Benching the Week's Second-Highest Scorer; Dak to the Future Loses by 0.8 to Pukachu Chews You
meme_brief: A team wins by nearly 90 points despite sitting a player who scored 43.4, while across the league two other teams play a game decided by less than a single point.
recap:
Demon44 put up 160.95 against Waffle House's 72.9, an 88.05-point margin that was the widest decision of the week. Waffle House got nothing from a huge chunk of its bench — DeVonta Smith scored 18.0 points without starting, while Brian Robinson started and managed 2.0, an 16-point gap that barely mattered given the scoreline. Demon44, for its part, had Trevor Lawrence sitting on the bench with 43.4 points, the league's second-highest total of the week, while Bryce Young started and put up 28.65. It did not cost them anything given the size of the win.

The tightest game of the week belonged to Pukachu Chews You and Dak to the Future, decided by 0.8 of a point — 97.3 to 96.5. Dak to the Future's own bench conspired against them: Tyler Shough went unstarted for 38.4 points while Dak Prescott started and scored 18.6, a 19.8-point gap that would have flipped the result by nearly 20 points had it gone the other way. Pukachu Chews You had its own smaller miscue, leaving Rico Dowdle's 6.4 points on the bench in favor of MarShawn Lloyd's 1.0, but it was cheap enough not to matter in a game this close.

Drake Maye was the league's top scorer at 35.15 points for Screaming Eagles, though it wasn't enough — Screaming Eagles lost to mikelanta 120.35 to 106.95. Mikelanta got there on the back of Kenneth Walker's 28.9 points, with Caleb Williams adding 22.55 and Isaiah Likely chipping in 21.9. Joe Mama Angie Daddy continued its strong season with a 113.8–101.15 win over Silverbacks, led by Tre Tucker's 26.2 points in his first week on the roster. Silverbacks sat Michael Penix's 34.35 points in favor of Aaron Rodgers' 25.55, an 8.8-point gap in a game they lost by 12.65 — close enough that it would have mattered.

Chuba Bucky Doo beat Meredith's Fan Club 124.6 to 102.1 behind a 30-point outing from Jayden Daniels. Meredith's Fan Club had the week's single costliest bench decision by margin — C.J. Stroud scored 36.1 points unstarted while Patrick Mahomes started for 14.2, a 21.9-point gap in a loss by 22.5. Had that swap gone the other way, the game is roughly a coin flip instead of a loss.
transaction_desk:
Joe Mama Angie Daddy ran the most activity of the week, cycling through Tre Tucker, Brandin Cooks, Christian Kirk and Dameon Pierce without spending any waiver priority on any of it — all uncontested pickups. Tre Tucker was the headline result: 26.2 points in his first week aboard, which makes the no-cost move look like theft so far. Dameon Pierce also delivered immediately, with 14.0 points for a player added off waivers for free.

Silverbacks burned their already-back-of-the-order priority (10th of 12) to reclaim Keaton Mitchell, which cost them essentially nothing given where they were sitting — he returned just 0.4 points this week, so there's no present return, but the cost was negligible too. Long Live King Henry spent the week shuffling quarterbacks for free — dropping Deshaun Watson for Tyler Huntley, then re-adding Watson off waivers in the same cycle — and Huntley rewarded the move with 18.05 points in his first week as the starter. Meredith's Fan Club added Kimani Vidal as a likely injury-insurance piece behind Omarion Hampton, a sensible depth grab that's already produced 5.5 points without costing any priority.

standings_narrative:
The division winners currently sit at the top of the bracket: Joe Mama Angie Daddy (5-1, Diamonds), Chuba Bucky Doo (4-2, Hearts), and Pukachu Chews You (3-3, Clubs) take seeds 1 through 3 by record. Dak to the Future (4-2) and mikelanta (3-3) occupy the next-best-record seeds 4 and 5, which puts mikelanta into the field despite sitting under .500 — their 781.9 points this season keep them ahead of the pack. The sixth and final spot goes to Screaming Eagles on total points (735.6), edging out Long Live King Henry (717.75), who sits just on the outside looking in as the top team left out of the bracket.

That leaves Silverbacks, Broke Dak Mountain, demon44, Waffle House and Meredith's Fan Club all outside the current picture, with Broke Dak Mountain and demon44 both at 3-3 but short on the points tiebreaker that's currently deciding the final seed. With the margins this thin, the points race for seed six is going to be worth watching every week from here out.
look_ahead: Next week, Chuba Bucky Doo hosts Screaming Eagles, Joe Mama Angie Daddy faces Pukachu Chews You, and Broke Dak Mountain takes on Waffle House. Silverbacks get Dak to the Future, Long Live King Henry plays demon44, and Meredith's Fan Club meets mikelanta.

running_jokes: Demon44 keeps winning by enormous margins while benching the league's best individual performances — this week it was a 43.4-point Trevor Lawrence sitting through an 88-point win.
Joe Mama Angie Daddy's bargain-bin waiver strategy (zero priority spent across four separate adds this week) keeps hitting, with Tre Tucker the latest free find to produce immediately.
Dak to the Future's bench mistakes are starting to have real consequences — a second straight week with a real error, this time nearly costing them a game decided by 0.8 points.
The points-based wildcard race is getting tight — Screaming Eagles currently hold it over Long Live King Henry by under 20 total points.
